'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Jim Li LS Dantooine Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jim Li]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Jim Li]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
